'''Barkmeal''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] with a soft fluid consistency.<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref> Coarse barkmeal was an ingredient in the [[deepwater Dac pie]] and in the [[sweet spore tart]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD"/>
